data.content_ref: inline:The structural rewrite that replaces a refuting subgraph with a single canonical 'defeater' node violates the determinism of the fixed point because it admits non-confluent rewrites under arbitrary refutation orderings, a flaw the target itself acknowledges as unproven. If applying rewrites in different orders yields distinct normalized graphs, the resulting grounded extensions will differ, destroying the determinism guarantee required by the problem context.
